# Green Pheonix Concept

> Performance marketing agency from Brașov, Romania. We build marketing systems that bring real clients — Meta Ads, Google Ads, organic social media, websites that convert.

## About
Green Pheonix Concept is an independent agency founded by Laurențiu Bogdan, specialized in performance marketing for serious businesses. We don't sell predefined packages — we listen first, recommend after. We operate in Romania, Italy and across European markets.

## Services
- [Meta Ads](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/servicii/meta-ads): Facebook and Instagram campaigns for lead generation and sales
- [Google Ads](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/servicii/google-ads): Search, Performance Max, YouTube campaigns
- [Social Media](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/servicii/social-media): Strategic organic content for authentic growth
- [Web Development](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/servicii/web-development): Websites that convert, optimized for results
- [Strategy & Audit](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/servicii/strategie-audit): Diagnosis before execution
- [Content Production](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/servicii/content-production): Content that sells, not just content

## Philosophy
1. **Simplicity that sells** — decorative complexity distracts
2. **Organic foundation** — ads alone don't work without a real organic presence
3. **Authenticity** — a conversion and an algorithm factor
4. **Strategy before execution** — diagnose, then act

## Case studies
- [Kokoro Ju Jitsu Academy](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/portofoliu/academia-kokoro-rebrand): Full rebrand and +595% organic Instagram growth in 3 months, with zero Meta Ads
- [Lemet Stone](https://greenpheonixconcept.com/portofoliu/lemet-stone-plugin-marketing): Custom SBC Calculator plugin + Meta Ads at 0.46 RON CPC, below the industry average

## How we work
1. **Discovery** (30 min, free) — we listen before we recommend
2. **Audit** (3-5 days) — we analyze what works and what doesn't
3. **Strategy** (5-7 days) — a clear recommended path
4. **Implementation** (variable) — technical and creative setup on milestones
5. **Optimization & reporting** (monthly) — we iterate on what works
